query: WITH feb AS (SELECT id, url FROM public.articles WHERE ingestion_run_id = 'v2-february-2026-general-news-2026-08-19') SELECT 'article_total' AS measure, count(*)::int AS value FROM feb UNION ALL SELECT 'article_graph_citations', count(DISTINCT c.article_id)::int FROM public.citations c JOIN feb f ON f.id = c.article_id WHERE c.resolved_node_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'article_event_memberships', count(DISTINCT ea.article_id)::int FROM public.event_articles ea JOIN feb f ON f.id = ea.article_id UNION ALL SELECT 'article_claim_links', count(DISTINCT ac.article_id)::int FROM public.article_claims ac JOIN feb f ON f.id = ac.article_id UNION ALL SELECT 'arc_events', count(*)::int FROM public.arc_events ae JOIN public.story_arcs a ON a.id = ae.arc_id WHERE a.slug = 'february-2026-source-mapped-policy-watch' UNION ALL SELECT 'timeline_nodes', count(*)::int FROM public.nodes n JOIN public.story_arcs a ON a.id = n.arc_id WHERE a.slug = 'february-2026-source-mapped-policy-watch' AND n.type = 'event' UNION ALL SELECT 'comparison_events', count(*)::int FROM public.events WHERE rule_version = 'v2-february-2026-general-news-2026-08-19' LIMIT 20;
